changelog:
- Standardized Light-White Menu Icons: Single uniform #E2E8F0 finish across all navigation and feature menu actions.
- Instant Native Browser Menu: Zero-delay BottomSheetDialog integration directly accessible from home essentials and 3-dots command.
- Authentic Publisher Brand Badges: Real vector logos for BBC News, ABC News, CNN, Reuters, The Guardian, NPR, NDTV, The Hindu, TOI, CBC, Der Spiegel, DW, and SMH with 'all' badge removed.
- Regional News Engine: Multi-source curated feeds for UK, India, Canada, Germany, Australia, and Global with quality filters and fair interleaving.
- Home Trending Feed: Compact on/off toggle beside country select and smooth horizontal trending article cards on home page.
